comments.author: @Worldunseen-f7h
comments.text: If Socotra’s isolation is what kept its unique evolution safe for millions of years, do you think opening it up for tourism will end up destroying the very magic everyone is flying out to see?

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: That is the single biggest ecological dilemma Socotra faces today, @Worldunseen-f7h. Unregulated visitor traffic, soil compaction, and invasive species could easily unravel millions of years of isolated evolution. Strict quotas and locally managed ecotourism are the only realistic hope to protect it. Thank you for raising such a crucial point!

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: Thank you, @RoamivoUSA! We’re delighted you enjoyed uncovering the mysteries of Socotra with us.

comments.author: @TravelHorizon360
comments.text: This place looks like another planet! 🌍 Should Socotra stay isolated to protect its magic, or should the whole world discover it? 👀🔥

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: A true modern dilemma, @TravelHorizon360! A strictly regulated ecotourism model seems like the only viable path—allowing people to appreciate its alien beauty while preventing mass commercialization from wiping out its unique endemic species.

comments.author: @BùiTrườngHuy-t5c
comments.text: Calling Socotra an "isolated lost world" while UAE developers pour millions into turning this pristine eco-system into another luxury tourist playground is hypocritical media nonsense

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: @BùiTrườngHuy-t5c You highlight a critical and very real geopolitical tension. Heavy foreign infrastructure investments and luxury tourism developments are placing severe pressure on Socotra’s delicate ecosystem and local autonomy. Our documentary aimed to showcase and preserve the memory of its millions-of-years-old evolutionary isolation and indigenous culture before modern commercialization reshapes it forever. We genuinely appreciate you bringing this crucial perspective to the discussion!
